A SMALL GUIDE TO A BIG WORLD

Find your place.

  1. Search for a place, or pan and zoom the map.
  2. Select Draw a polygon and click to place at least three points.
  3. Click the first point or press Enter to close your shape.
  4. Drag any vertex to refine your boundary. Copy or download the coordinates.

Shortcuts: / to search · Enter to finish · Backspace to undo a point · Escape to cancel.

Coordinates use WGS 84. The table shows latitude, longitude; GeoJSON uses longitude, latitude. Measurements are approximate. Your last completed selection is saved in this browser.
